description: This file defines a Migration class for the OrangeHRM system's version 4.7.0, extending an abstract migration class and implementing methods to define migration behavior and version information.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for version 4.7.0 of OrangeHRM, inheriting from AbstractMigration and implementing version-specific methods.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Defines the migration logic to be executed when applying this migration. Currently, it has no database changes for this version.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.7' indicating this migration's target version.
